violations.why: writer1_isr (prio 2) can be preempted by closer1_isr (prio 5), which overwrites var1 before writer1 reads it back.
closer1_isr can preempt writer1_isr between its two reads, so the two reads can return different values.
closer4_isr (prio 1) is preempted by closer2_isr (prio 3), which reads var2 between the two writes and sees the intermediate value.
The var3++ in writer2_isr (prio 2) is a read-modify-write. writer4_isr (prio 4) can preempt it and write var3, and that write is then lost.
writer4_isr (prio 4) can preempt closer2_isr (prio 3) and reset expect_close between its write of 42 and its check.
writer4_isr can preempt closer2_isr between its check of expect_close and its final write.
writer3_isr (prio 3) can preempt closer3_isr (prio 2) and reset expect_close before closer3_isr checks it.
writer3_isr can preempt closer3_isr between its check and its final write.
Higher-priority writers can preempt closer4_isr (prio 1) and reset expect_close before it checks it.
A higher-priority writer can preempt closer4_isr between its check and its final write.
writer4_isr can preempt closer2_isr and set count to 0 after closer2_isr set it to 1, so the check sees a different value.
writer3_isr (prio 3) can preempt closer3_isr (prio 2) and set count to 0 between its write and its read.
writer3_isr can preempt closer4_isr and set count to 0 between its write and its read.
closer1_isr (prio 5) can preempt writer1_isr and set count to 1, so writer1_isr's check sees 1 instead of its own 0.
closer1_isr can preempt writer2_isr and set count to 1 between its write and its read.
closer1_isr or writer4_isr can preempt writer3_isr and change count between its write and its read.
closer1_isr (prio 5) can preempt closer2_isr and write the buffer between closer2_isr's write and its read.
closer2_isr (prio 3) or closer1_isr can preempt closer3_isr and write the buffer between closer3_isr's write and its read.
Higher-priority closers can preempt closer4_isr and write the buffer between its write and its read.
